title: NBA Logo Quiz Part 4: Hard Mode
headline: NBA Logo Quiz Part 4: Name The Team From A Tiny Piece Of Its Logo
description: A hard NBA logo quiz: eight tiny pieces of NBA team logos, about 2% of each logo. Guess the team, tap to reveal the answer, keep score and share your result.
intro: Every piece below is a small square cut from a current NBA team logo, about one fiftieth of the whole mark. No full letters, no team names, no giveaways. Each piece still holds one real detail, a color pair, a curve or an edge that belongs to only one team.
Make your guess, then tap Show The Answer. Be honest and mark whether you got it, and your score adds up at the bottom.

items.piece: The red stripe at the top of the ball, with navy and silver below.
items.fact: The Wizards' monument ball puts the Washington Monument inside a basketball. It became the center of the primary logo in 2015.

items.piece: The red, white and blue edge of the ball at its lower right.
items.fact: The Pistons brought back a version of their 1979 to 1996 basketball logo in May 2017, ahead of their move downtown.

items.piece: Gold and navy feathers on the pelican's left wing.
items.fact: The Pelicans' logo was unveiled in January 2013. The pelican is Louisiana's state bird.

items.piece: Silver and black strands of the horse's mane.
items.fact: The Mavericks' horse head arrived for the 2001-02 season, replacing the cowboy hat logo the team had used since 1980.

items.piece: The gold stripe running across the navy P, with the silver outline.
items.fact: The Pacers' logo puts a gold basketball inside the curve of a navy P.

items.piece: Where the purple banner meets the top of the gray basketball.
items.fact: The Kings unveiled their current logo in April 2016, a modern take on the team's classic crown and basketball.

items.piece: The gold and red rings at the top of the circle, against navy.
items.fact: The Nuggets unveiled their current logos in June 2018, looking back to the team's Mountain Peak and Pickaxe eras.

items.piece: A white stripe through the red 7.
items.fact: The 13 stars over the Sixers' 76 stand for the original American colonies. The current logo set arrived in 2015.
